issues.title: Record activation boundaries and validate the plan
issues.body:
## Goal

Make later activation explicit and keep the public plan honest.

## Implementation steps

1. 2h — Read parent instructions and reconcile the selected project, repository, and activation authorization.
2. 4h — Create activation/status and reserve ledgers; add a local backlog checker for exact keys, totals, IDs, and DAG.
3. 2h — Review checks and document the relative release windows.

The estimate includes implementation, learning, normal fixes, tests, documentation and review. Work starts only after project activation.

## Expected output paths

planning/activation.json; planning/reserve-log.md; scripts/check_backlog.py; tests/test_backlog.py

## Acceptance criteria

Before selection, activation remains null and status planned. On authorized selection, record date and the single 16h/week allocation. Checker rejects cycles, unknown milestones, child double-counting, and totals above 800h.

## Validation and review evidence

python scripts/check_backlog.py; python -m pytest tests/test_backlog.py -q. Exercise one invalid graph in memory and retain its expected failure.

Store commands, results, hashes, actual/remaining hours, limitations and reviewer findings in planning/evidence/IE-001.md. Apply the execution plan's done/blocked and Luna/GPT-5.6-to-Astra handoff policy. Do not mark unrun checks passed.

## Dependencies

None; selection/activation authorization is required before implementation.

## Data/method pitfalls

Public repository existence is not activation or functional delivery. Do not change shared AGENTS.md or create remote issues.

issues.title: Define the AP use case and discovery hypotheses
issues.body:
## Goal

Specify the operational decision and a testable demand hypothesis.

## Implementation steps

1. 2h — Map invoice receipt, exception review, approval, and export for one fictional organization.
2. 4h — Write ten fictional review tasks, comparison protocol, and optional interview questions.
3. 2h — Review exclusions, success criteria, and unsupported commercialization claims.

The estimate includes implementation, learning, normal fixes, tests, documentation and review. Work starts only after project activation.

## Expected output paths

docs/product/discovery.md; docs/product/task-script.md; docs/product/assumptions.md

## Acceptance criteria

Ten tasks include valid, missing-value, arithmetic, duplicate, and PO-conflict cases. Each identifies operator action and observable result. Separate workflow hypotheses from measured evidence; private data and recruitment are not finish prerequisites.

## Validation and review evidence

Desk-replay all ten tasks against the scope table; record unresolved assumptions and the planned M6 measures.

Store commands, results, hashes, actual/remaining hours, limitations and reviewer findings in planning/evidence/IE-002.md. Apply the execution plan's done/blocked and Luna/GPT-5.6-to-Astra handoff policy. Do not mark unrun checks passed.

## Dependencies

IE-001

## Data/method pitfalls

Do not invent interviews or send outreach without authorization. Existing annotated public data is permitted; no manual dataset creation.

docs/licenses/ledger.json; docs/licenses/README.md; scripts/check_licenses.py; tests/test_licenses.py

Each candidate records artifact kind, revision/hash or pending status, evidence URL, use-specific decision, notices, and obligations. Unknown assets cannot be fetched/used. Tesseract engine and eng/por weights have separate entries; NC/ambiguous DocVQA/XFUND remain blocked absent explicit clearance.

## Validation and review evidence

python scripts/check_licenses.py; python -m pytest tests/test_licenses.py -q. A simulated unknown/NC use must fail the commercial-evaluation gate.

python -m pytest tests/test_eligibility.py -q; run calibration evaluation and compare raw predictions, coverage and joint critical-field accuracy.
